a: R61 up to $150,000 (about 23 awards, $5.4M total); R33 up to $300,000 (about 14 awards, $6.6M total) - forecast figures
dt: Forecast: NOFOs RFA-CA-28-001 (R61) and RFA-CA-28-002 (R33) estimated to post Jan 15, 2027 with applications due about Jun 4, 2027 (estimates, not posted dates).
e: NCI's IMAT program funds development of new measurement, imaging, sensing and molecular-analysis technologies focused on cancer research or care: R61 for early proof-of-concept work, R33 for further development and validation of technologies with demonstrated feasibility. Universities, including foreign institutions per the forecast, may apply; no citizenship limit for PIs is stated.
n: NCI Innovative Molecular Analysis Technologies (IMAT): Early-Stage R61 and Advanced Development R33 - forecast
unv: Both NOFOs are still forecasts on Grants.gov; post and due dates and award figures are agency estimates.
